ocr_cases.title: Rainwater Analytics for Regional Libraries
ocr_cases.body: Australian councils need auditable evidence about tank levels and rainfall. This synthetic poster evaluates a local sensor dashboard using bounded sampling, transparent calculations, and staff review.

ocr_cases.title: Students’ Low-Carbon Commute Map
ocr_cases.body: A compressed route poster compares walking, cycling and bus options near campus. Mild noise and small labels test whether the document remains readable without changing staff authority.

ocr_cases.title: Secure QR Check-In Without Cloud Storage
ocr_cases.metadata_title: Secure QR Check-In Without Cloud Storage
ocr_cases.body: The prototype validates QR tokens locally and retains only synthetic aggregate counts. Threat boundaries exclude credentials, browser automation, remote fetching, and publication decisions.

ocr_cases.title: Microgrid Forecasting: Stage 2
ocr_cases.body: Stage two forecasts demand for a synthetic campus microgrid using fixed intervals. The stage number is materially authoritative even when every other title character agrees.

ocr_cases.title: Bushfire Shelter Capacity Dashboard
ocr_cases.body: A deidentified simulation displays shelter capacity, travel time and accessibility status. Colour-independent labels preserve meaning for emergency planning in regional Australia.

ocr_cases.title: Coastal Sensor Calibration — Trial A
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic salinity and turbidity readings are calibrated against fixed reference values. A scanned low-contrast layout tests punctuation, technical terms and compact annotations.

ocr_cases.title: Accessible Wayfinding for Building 80
ocr_cases.body: The prototype describes step-free paths, lift status and tactile landmarks through a synthetic building plan. Staff confirm all route claims before any public use.

ocr_cases.title: Heat-Safe Housing Review 2026
ocr_cases.body: A compressed poster compares shading, insulation and night ventilation for synthetic dwellings. The reporting year changes project identity and must never become automatic agreement.

ocr_cases.title: Battery Health Estimation with LSTM Signals
ocr_cases.metadata_title: Battery Health Estimation with LSTM Signals
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic voltage and temperature sequences demonstrate a local forecasting experiment. The poster distinguishes measured evidence from recommendations and keeps the reviewer authoritative.

ocr_cases.title: Koala Corridor Evidence Tracker
ocr_cases.body: The synthetic tracker combines habitat observations with bounded map references. Faint text, mixed sizes and image noise test OCR without introducing real locations or wildlife records.

ocr_cases.title: Café Queue Insights for Orientation Week
ocr_cases.metadata_title: Café Queue Insights for Orientation Week
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic arrival counts compare three service layouts during a fictional orientation week. The analysis uses Australian English and preserves the accented project title.

ocr_cases.title: Flood Alert Network — Zone A
ocr_cases.body: A two-column scanned poster describes threshold alerts for a fictional catchment. The single zone character is a material identifier and approximate OCR cannot approve it.

ocr_cases.title: Digital Twin for Tram Stop Accessibility
ocr_cases.metadata_title: Digital Twin for Tram Stop Accessibility
ocr_cases.body: A synthetic digital twin records kerb height, shelter clearance and passenger information features. Two columns separate the method from accessibility observations.

ocr_cases.title: Re-Use Hub: Materials Passport
ocr_cases.body: This compressed prototype records synthetic timber, steel and fixture attributes for later re-use. Small two-column text tests hyphens, punctuation and construction vocabulary.

ocr_cases.title: Edge-AI Detection of Leaking Taps
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic acoustic features are processed locally to flag possible water loss. The model offers assistive evidence only; facilities staff verify every maintenance decision.

ocr_cases.title: Solar Canopy Controller — 10 kW
ocr_cases.body: A compact two-column poster explains a synthetic power controller and its bounded telemetry. Rated capacity is materially different when one digit changes.

ocr_cases.title: Neighbourhood Noise Mapping at Night
ocr_cases.body: A fictional survey maps equivalent sound levels without retaining addresses or participant data. The Australian spelling and two-column method remain explicit.

ocr_cases.title: Cyclist’s Safe-Passing Distance Display
ocr_cases.body: A low-resolution scan presents synthetic ultrasonic distances and a handlebar warning display. Curly apostrophes, a hyphen and small text increase realistic OCR difficulty.

ocr_cases.title: Food-Waste Audit for Campus Kitchens
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic mass measurements compare preparation waste, leftovers and unavoidable scraps. The poster presents uncertainty and does not identify a real kitchen or staff member.

ocr_cases.title: Smart Bin Pilot: Trial 1
ocr_cases.body: The fictional pilot measures fill estimates and collection intervals. Compression and faint columns are difficult, while the one-character trial number remains materially authoritative.

ocr_cases.title: Urban Tree Canopy Change, 2019–2026
ocr_cases.body: A synthetic geospatial comparison reports canopy classes and uncertainty across fictional precincts. The date range and en dash are part of the exact title.

ocr_cases.title: Indoor Air Sensor QA/QC Workflow
ocr_cases.body: A compact technical poster checks synthetic particulate and carbon-dioxide readings. Slash punctuation, acronyms, faint contrast and small labels stress text ordering.

ocr_cases.title: Privacy-Preserving Study Space Counter
ocr_cases.body: The synthetic system counts occupied zones without recording faces or device identifiers. Three columns describe sensing, aggregation and human review boundaries.

ocr_cases.title: Lift Demand Forecast — Level 4
ocr_cases.body: A noisy three-column scan shows fictional lift demand by interval. The level digit is a material project distinction and approximate recovery must remain review evidence.

ocr_cases.title: Anaerobic Digestion Yield Explorer
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic feedstock ratios demonstrate methane-yield calculations with stated uncertainty. The three-column layout separates context, method and bounded findings.

ocr_cases.title: Drought-Resilient Garden Planner
ocr_cases.body: A compressed synthetic poster compares native plants, soil cover and irrigation intervals. Dense three-column text and low resolution represent a difficult PP1 layout.

ocr_cases.title: NFC Tool-Lending Register Prototype
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic NFC tags link tools to deidentified loan records. The prototype has no database credentials and cannot approve access, publication or real transactions.

ocr_cases.title: Electric Bus Monitor — Route 7
ocr_cases.body: Fictional telemetry shows charge, delay and energy use in three compact columns. The route digit is a one-character material negative that must never auto-agree.

ocr_cases.title: Robotic Sorting of Recyclable Packaging
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic images classify cardboard, metal and rigid plastic for an assistive sorting prototype. Error cases are shown explicitly and a person remains responsible.

ocr_cases.title: Wearable Hydration Cue for Fieldwork
ocr_cases.body: A noisy scanned poster describes synthetic temperature and activity thresholds. It makes no medical claim and presents the wearable as an optional fieldwork cue.

ocr_cases.title: Acoustic Detection of Cane-Toad Calls
ocr_cases.body: A synthetic spectrogram study compares local call features and background noise. No real ecological record or location is included in the benchmark poster.

ocr_cases.title: Campus Demand Model X
ocr_cases.body: A compressed three-column poster compares synthetic occupancy and electricity profiles. The final model letter changes identity and must remain a human-review mismatch.

native_controls.title: Native Text Control — Circular Economy
native_controls.body: A synthetic born-digital control proves that native extraction remains the deterministic first path after OCR benchmarking.

native_controls.title: Native Text Control: Water Quality
native_controls.body: This second synthetic control preserves punctuation and three-column native text without requiring an OCR provider.
